title: 'Enable See Financial Data?' dialog — Enable: turns See Financial Data on and keeps the box ticked
custom_preconds: 1. The 'Enable See Financial Data?' dialog is open (opened by ticking Part sales while See Financial Data is OFF).
custom_steps:
1. Click Enable.
  2. Look at the Part sales View box and the See Financial Data toggle.
custom_expected:
The dialog closes.

See Financial Data is now ON.

The Part sales View box stays ticked.
evidence: UI: Enable on the SFD dialog turns See Financial Data ON and keeps Part sales View+Create&Edit ticked.
